metadata.title: Eromba | Manipuri Recipe
metadata.description:
The ingredients required are
3 medium sized tomatoes
3 medium sized potatoes 7-8 dried red chilies
1 dried ghost pepper if you can handle the heat its optional
3-4 fermented fish salt to taste


The recipe of the dish is really simple and is very easy to prepare.

To make this delicious dish the first thing that we need to do is peel and cut the potatoes into large pieces.

Pressure cook the potatoes along with dry red chilies and tomatoes for about 10 minutes.


You can choose to use ghost pepper instead of the regular dried red chilies, it imparts a beautiful flavor to the dish, but I cannot handle the heat, so I am happy sticking to regular chilies. 

While the potatoes are in the pressure cooker, dry roast the fermented fish on a tava and once fully done, gently wash them in a bowl of water. 

Fermented fish are very delicate and washing them under running water or soaking them to wash is not advisible as the will completely disintegrate. 

Once the pressure is released, fish out the pieces of potatoes, tomatoes and chilies into a bowl.

The tomatoes skin can be removed easily and once they're out, they are all set to be mashed.

I use the bottom of a tumbler to mash potatoes, Its easy that way.

The dry chilies can be ground to fine paste in a mixer grinder, along with fermented fish. 


once the chilies are ground into fine paste, the job gets very easy, just mix the whole thing well and voila your Eromba is ready.
 
Thank you for watching.
